hard_failures.detail: The declared consistency_evidence_sha256 now resolves (I2a closed), but the 495-byte artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json records only the two paths plus consistent=true; it embeds neither the measured sha256 of research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml (0abb9ed8a961) nor of the supplement (d7419b4e8963). hard_failures.axis: evidence path rewritten after the binding stamp

hard_failures.falsifier: A controller ruling recorded in the map designating one registry authoritative, or an F0 allowed-list amendment listing scc_c2_future_inextendibility at a pinned hash.
